# TeacherWork Module — Pattern Summary

## 1. Existing List/Edit ascx in `hos/Controls/TeacherWork/`

**Hiện có 2 control, không có `Edit.ascx` riêng** — edit inline trong `List.ascx`.

| File | Vai trò |
|------|---------|
| `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\TeacherWork\List.ascx` | GV tự nhập công việc khác |
| `List.ascx.cs` / `List.ascx.designer.cs` | |
| `ReviewList.ascx` | QL duyệt công việc |
| `ReviewList.ascx.cs` / `ReviewList.ascx.designer.cs` | |

**Naming / namespace**
- Namespace: `InformationWeb.Controls.TeacherWork`
- Class: `List`, `ReviewList` (không prefix module)
- Kế thừa: `ControlBase` (`hos\Utility\ControlBase.cs`)
- Using: `SimsObject`, `WebGlobal`, `System.Data`

**Code-behind patterns chung**

```12:16:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\TeacherWork\List.ascx.cs
namespace InformationWeb.Controls.TeacherWork
{
    public partial class List : ControlBase
    {
```

- `ViewState` cho `SortBy` / `SortDesc`
- `LoadData()` → `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded obj = new SIM_TeachingTimeAdded()` → `obj.GetDataTable("SP_NAME", "@Param", value, ...)`
- `Repeater` + sort qua `LinkButton` (`lbtTitle_Click`)
- `UpdatePanel` (`udpList`, `udpMain`)
- Filter: `UYearSemester2`; GV page dùng `User.UserName` làm `@TeacherID`
- Save: `BeginTransaction()` → loop Repeater → `AddOrEdit_Request()` / `ExecNonQuery()` → `CommitTransaction()`
- Log: `SYS_ActionLog().WriteActionLog(...)`

**UI filter controls đăng ký trong ascx**


---

## 2. UTeacher2 — filtering pattern

**Files**
- `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\Sims\UTeacher2.ascx`
- `UTeacher2.ascx.cs` / `UTeacher2.ascx.designer.cs`

**Cấu trúc UI:** Khoa → Bộ môn → Giảng viên → nút Tìm kiếm.

**Load & filter teacher**

```55:84:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\Sims\UTeacher2.ascx.cs
        private void LoadData()
        {
            DataTable dtbScience = new SIM_ScienceDAO().Search();
            WebGlobal.InitDropDownList(ddlScienceID, dtbScience, SIM_Science.C_SCIENCEID, SIM_Science.C_SCIENCENAME, "--Chọn--");
            // ...
            DataTable dtbTeacher = new SIM_TeacherDAO().Search();
            if (dtbTeacher != null)
            {
                foreach (DataRow drw in dtbTeacher.Rows)
                    drw["TeacherID"] = drw["TeacherID"].ToString().ToLower();
                Session["TEACHER_TABLE"] = dtbTeacher;
                WebGlobal.InitDropDownList(ddlTeacherID, dtbTeacher, SIM_Teacher.C_TEACHERID, "FullName", "--Chọn--", strCondition);
            }
```

**Event pattern (bắt buộc wire trong Page_Load của host)**

```149:160:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\Sims\UTeacher2.ascx.cs
        protected void btnSearch_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchClick != null)
                SearchClick(ddlScienceID.SelectedValue == "" ? null : ddlScienceID.SelectedValue,
                            ddlSubjectGroupID.SelectedValue == "" ? null : ddlSubjectGroupID.SelectedValue,
                            ddlTeacherID.SelectedValue == "" ? null : ddlTeacherID.SelectedValue);
        }

        public delegate void SearchDelegate(object scienceID, object subjectGroupID, object teacherID);
        public event SearchDelegate SearchClick = null;
```

**Ví dụ host:** `SummaryScheduleOfTeacher.ascx.cs`

```497:507:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\Sims\SummaryScheduleOfTeacher.ascx.cs
            uTeacher.SearchClick += new InformationWeb.Controls.Sims.UTeacher2.SearchDelegate(SearchClick);
            if (!IsPostBack)
            {
                // ...
                    uTeacher.TeacherID = objUser.UserName.ToLower();
                    uYearSemester1.LoadData();
                    SearchClick(null, null, objUser.UserName);
```

**Lưu ý:** Trang QL duyệt công việc dùng **`UTeacher5`** (thêm `PermissionID` + lọc theo `SYS_User_SearchPermission_ScienceAndSubjectGroup`) — phù hợp hơn cho trang admin NCKH.

## 4. Object layer cho bảng SIM_

**Trong repo web:** entity nằm trong **`SimsObject.dll`** (`..\bin\SimsObject.dll`), không có source trong `con-thontin-hueeee`.

**Reference mẫu** (project anh em `nam-dinh\SimsObject\`):

| File | Nội dung |
|------|----------|
| `Base\SIM_TeachingTimeAddedBase.cs` | Properties, `Get()`, `Add()`, `Update()`, `Delete()`, `GetDataTable()`, transaction |
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.cs` | Custom methods: `AddOrEdit_Request()`, `AddOrEdit()` |

**Pattern gọi từ UI**

```58:63:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\hos\Controls\TeacherWork\List.ascx.cs
            SIM_TeachingTimeAdded obj = new SIM_TeachingTimeAdded();
            dtbData = obj.GetDataTable("SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_SearchForEdit_Request",
                                        "@YearID", uYearSemester.YearID,

                                        "@TeacherID", User.UserName);
```

**Cần tạo mới (ngoài repo web hoặc rebuild DLL):**

- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.cs` với methods tương ứng SP

## 5. Stored procedure naming & parameters (SIM module)

**Quy ước:** `{Module}_{Entity}_{Action}` → `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_Reviewed`

| SP | Action | Params chính |
|----|--------|--------------|
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_SearchForEdit_Request` | List cho GV edit | `@TeacherID`, `@YearID`, `@Semester` |
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_Reviewed` | List cho QL duyệt | `@ScienceID`, `@SubjectGroupID`, `@TeacherID`, `@YearID`, `@Semester` (nullable) |
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_UpdateReview` | Update duyệt | `@TeachingTimeAddedID`, `@IsReviewed`, `@ReviewedDate`, ... |
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_AddOrEdit_Request` | Insert/update (Object) | qua entity method |
| `SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_DELETE` | Delete (Object) | `@TeachingTimeAddedID` |

**Pattern SP list thường dùng:**
- `#tblData` temp table từ bảng chính
- Join lookup tables
- Filter: `(@Param is null or @Param = '' or Column = @Param)`
- Sort trong SP hoặc `DataTable.DefaultView.Sort` ở UI

**Cho `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch` cần SP (gợi ý):**
- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Search` — list + join teacher name
- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Get` — load 1 bản ghi edit
- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_AddOrEdit` — save
- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_DELETE` — xóa (nếu cần)

DDL bảng đã có: `g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.sql`

## 7. SIM_Teacher — join tên giáng viên

**3 cách trong codebase:**

**A. Dropdown filter (UTeacher2/5):** `SIM_TeacherDAO().Search()` → cột `"FullName"` (computed trong SP search)

**B. SP join trực tiếp (ReviewList):**

```67:67:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_Reviewed.sql
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName as TeacherName,
```

Join path filter:
```44:50:g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\con-thontin-hueeee\SIM_TeachingTimeAdded_Reviewed.sql
	From SIM_TeachingTimeAdded
		Inner Join SIM_Teacher on SIM_Teacher.TeacherID = SIM_TeachingTimeAdded.TeacherID
		Left Join SIM_SubjectGroup on SIM_SubjectGroup.SubjectGroupID = SIM_Teacher.SubjectGroupID
	Where ...
		and (@ScienceID is null or @ScienceID = '' or SIM_SubjectGroup.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
```

**C. Object get 1 record:** `new SIM_Teacher().Get(teacherID)` hoặc `GetDataTable("SIM_Teacher_Search", "@TeacherID", ...)`

**Cho TeachingTimeResearch list:** nên join giống pattern B trong SP `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Search`.

## Gợi ý kiến trúc cho 2 trang mới

**TeachingTimeResearchList (QL):**
- Mẫu: `ReviewList.ascx` + `UTeacher5` + `UYearSemester2`
- SP: `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Search` với `@ScienceID`, `@SubjectGroupID`, `@TeacherID`, `@YearID`, `@Semester`
- Repeater → link/button mở Edit

**TeachingTimeResearchEdit:**
- Mẫu: `ScheduleChecking\Edit.ascx` (modal popup trong List) **hoặc** form riêng
- Fields từ bảng: `TeachHour`, `ResearchHour`, `SavePrev`, `ResearchNow`, `ResearchContent`, `DecisionNo`, `TotalHour`, `SaveNext`, `LackHour`
- Save qua `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.AddOrEdit()`

**Nếu trang dành cho GV tự nhập** (giống `List.ascx`): bỏ `UTeacher2/5`, filter `@TeacherID = User.UserName`, không cần chọn khoa.
